metadata.description: Agent skills for issue-driven delivery and per-stack implementation on Claude Code, OpenCode and Copilot CLI.

plugins.name: shared
plugins.description: Base skills every other group uses: stack detection (detect-techstack), language-agnostic implementation rules (implementation), code review (code-review), bug diagnosis (diagnose) and the prerequisite check (check-prerequisites).

plugins.name: github
plugins.description: GitHub workflow: issue hierarchy (Epic, Feature, PBI, Task, Bug) with native sub-issues, pull requests into the release branch, release branches (cut, finish).

plugins.name: delivery
plugins.description: Issue-driven delivery: /deliver with subagents on any harness, open-decision interview (grill-me), planning (planner), run retrospective (retro) and the installer (skills-install). Needs shared and github.

plugins.name: statusline
plugins.description: Context status line and subagent status line for Claude Code and Copilot CLI (context-statusline).

plugins.name: ts
plugins.description: TypeScript and Node.js: implementation conventions and review rules, Vitest testing, project scaffolding, Biome or ESLint/Prettier with Husky, pnpm workflow, MCP server generator.

plugins.name: py
plugins.description: Python: implementation conventions and review rules, pytest testing, project scaffolding with uv and ruff.

plugins.name: ng
plugins.description: Angular 21+: implementation conventions and review rules, Vitest/TestBed testing, project scaffolding, NgRx Signal Store, AG Grid. skills-install adds angular/skills (angular-developer).

plugins.name: dotnet
plugins.description: C#/.NET: implementation conventions and review rules, NUnit/NSubstitute/Shouldly testing, solution scaffolding with Central Package Management, MCP server generator. skills-install adds the dotnet plugin of dotnet/skills.

plugins.name: rust
plugins.description: Rust: implementation conventions and review rules, cargo test / nextest testing with mockall and proptest.

plugins.name: go
plugins.description: Go: implementation conventions and review rules, table-driven tests with testify and the race detector.

plugins.name: skill-tooling
plugins.description: Contributor tooling for this repository: write, audit and slim SKILL.md files. Not part of the all preset.
